title: Owner Tally, KPI Acceptance Checksheet
body:
Purpose:
This is a compact working checksheet for the upcoming feature launch window. Goal is to: 1) produce a concise owner/hand-off list for each gate, 2) specify KPI acceptance thresholds (pass/warn/fail), 3) capture assumptions that must be validated preflight, and 4) list quick contingencies tied to metric triggers. Use this doc during staff syncs and as the single source for last-minute signoffs.

High-level launch slices (what this doc covers):
- Beta cohort activation (first 5k users)
- Public rollout (phased 0–100%)
- Dedicated/Dedicated-to-Hosted fallback (capacity tiering)

Owner tally (quick reference):
- Product ops: Emma Chen — launch owner, cross-team coordination, final go/no-go
- Eng serving runtime: Jordan Patel — model rollout, autoscale policy, KV cache readiness
- Infra / Dedicated: Luis Martínez — reserved capacity checks, GPU burn schedule, failover routes
- Console + Rollouts: Priya Nair — rollout config, canary traffic split, telemetry hooks
- Customer Success: Asha Rao — beta customer communications and onboarding cadence
- SRE oncall: team-oncall rotation (primary: SRE-1, backup: SRE-2) — incident triage

Milestones (date anchors):
- 2025-12-01: Preflight smoke on staging (owner: Jordan)
- 2025-12-05: Capacity soak (12h) on Dedicated pool (owner: Luis)
- 2025-12-08: Canary 1 (1%) – internal only (owner: Priya)
- 2025-12-10: Beta cohort launch (owner: Emma + Asha)
- 2025-12-15: Public slow-roll start (owner: Emma)

KPI acceptance matrix (pass | warn | fail):
- 95th pct latency (inference token path): pass < 220ms | warn 220-300ms | fail >300ms
- Error rate (5xx + model-fallbacks): pass < 0.2% | warn 0.2–1% | fail >1%
- Token cost per 1k reqs (hosted billable estimate): pass < $0.75 | warn $0.75–1.25 | fail >$1.25
- Successful streaming completions: pass >99% | warn 96–99% | fail <96%
- User-facing regression rate (quality evals tied to sample prompts): pass <1.5% regressions | warn 1.5–4% | fail >4%

Acceptance checks (pre-go):
- Telemetry sanity: route-specific dashboards are populated and show historical baselines (owner: Priya)
- Canary traffic is isolated and has a rollback path pre-configured (owner: Priya)
- Autoscale policies set with burst buffer and cooldowns documented (owner: Luis)
- Key model versions pinned and smoke evals run against curated prompt set (owner: Jordan)
- Cost burn forecast validated against commit (owner: Emma / Finance brief)

Contingency triggers + immediate actions (short runbook):
- Trigger: 95th latency crosses fail (>300ms) for 10m
  - Action: Redirect new traffic to lower-latency variant (fallback model) + increase batch cooldowns; Page Eng oncall; pause rollforward.
- Trigger: Error rate spikes >1% sustained for 5m
  - Action: Rollback canary -> isolate failing route -> enable degraded mode with cached responses for top 10 endpoints.
- Trigger: Cost burn unexpectedly exceeds warn band by 30% in first 24h
  - Action: Throttle non-critical routes, engage finance to review floating limits, consider quantized model variant for public rollout.

Staffing & shift notes (short):
- Coverage window for day-0 public start: 24h SRE coverage with 1 product ops lead, 1 eng runtime, 1 infra lead, 1 CS rep.
- Escalation ladder (call sequence): SRE -> Eng runtime -> Infra -> Product ops exec.
- Oncall hand-off checklist: attach latest canary logs, top-10 errors, known mitigations to the incident channel.

Unresolved assumptions & preflight blockers (must clear before go):
- Assumption: KV cache priming will reduce median latency by ~30% for typical prompt mix. Validation needed: 12h soak with representative requests (owner: Jordan).
- Assumption: Dedicated pool autoscale warmup time < 90s. Validation: controlled spike test (owner: Luis).
- Blocker: One enterprise beta customer requires IP allowlist and VPC peering configured — work in progress (owner: Asha).
- Blocker: Missing one regression benchmark for a recent prompt family (owner: Jordan).

Quick QA smoke checklist (to run on staging and canary):
- Basic inference flow end-to-end (text generation + streaming) — 10 requests across lengths (short/medium/long).
- Function/tool-calling route with a simulated external tool (mock) to verify timeouts and fallbacks.
- Embedding route sanity: dimensionality and sign checks, latency per call.
- Billing tag propagation: verify request tags appear in cost telemetry for sample calls.

Communication plan (short bullets):
- Preflight note to beta cohort (Asha): 48h before beta open
- Internal launch brief to Eng/SRE/Support: 24h before canary
- Public launch FAQ draft (product ops + CS) live by 2025-12-09

Open decisions to resolve this week:
- Final threshold for streaming completion warn band (Priya to propose by 2025-11-20)
- Exact size of dedicated burst buffer (Luis + Jordan to simulate; result by 2025-11-25)

Next steps (who does what):
- Jordan: run KV priming soak and upload graphs to confluence (due 2025-11-20)
- Luis: run dedicated autoscale warmup test and share logs (due 2025-11-22)
- Priya: confirm canary rollback steps in the console and run a manual rollback rehearsal (due 2025-11-24)
- Emma: consolidate final pass/fail signoff matrix and schedule preflight dry-run (due 2025-11-26)

Notes / context: This is intentionally compact — keep this doc as the one-pager we reference in the final 72h runway. Convert to the canonical spreadsheet if we need per-minute telemetry capture or headcount shift planning.

Last edit notes: 2025-12-20 heavy edits to KPI thresholds after autoscale soak; moved beta to 2025-12-10 to accommodate CS readiness.
